comments.text:
15:15 nope sorry would've walked away, sun faded ass games, buddy should invest in a canopy if he wants to charge those kind of prices. They are like $50 at walmart lmfao
You can get a sealed Oddworld for like $30, you paid what those were "worth" exactly. I wouldn't have paid more than $3 per, dude can get boned. The first guy was prepared and takes care of his stuff. You did good on that first grab and the last was really good.
There was some value in that first 360 box too, if he would've done like $3-5 per. Even some at like $8 would still be pretty a good deal and still have a significant profit margin. LFD2 is always a grab if someone only wants like $5 for it.
comments.author: @tacticalmattress

comments.text: Like it's actually kinda torturous to see him just killing all those games with UV. Once you understand what UV does to plastics, you'd be selling off a few games to pay for a few nice canopies to keep things covered (not you, but him)
